{"code":"        """Decide whether *entry* is stale and should be refreshed.

        BUG_44: the comparison is inverted -- it returns ``True`` when
        the entry is still fresh and ``False`` when it is actually stale.
        """
        # BUG_44: inverted stale check -- returns True when NOT stale
        return now >= entry.stale_at
", "comments":"Flip the stale comparison so refresh occurs when the current time meets or exceeds the entry stale timestamp."}
